beats.title: A. 1919: the veteran
beats.see: Caption 1919. He pats the brass plaque on the bench back (LEST WE FORGET. PRESENTED BY THE WHALEBY TRUST). The veteran, trouser leg pinned, stands and goes; a WELCOME HOME bunting scrap on the ground.

lines.how: pats the plaque, not looking up from his paper

beats.title: B. Now: the nurse
beats.see: Caption Now. Same pat, same paper, same flick of the hand. The nurse goes; a second plate under the first: THANK YOU HEROES.

beats.title: C. Same bench
beats.see: He lowers the paper and tips his hat to camera.
beats.sfx: one page-turn, one dry brass tink
